name: Soloviev_GSJt
description: Validation Test 4: same geometry/coils/mesh as the standard Soloviev case, but Jt.txt and Dshape.txt come from a converged FIXED_GS_SOLVER run (GS_solver.h's own polynomial p/g profiles), so the coil-current solve here uses a plasma current that GS_solver.h will later reproduce internally in SEMIFREE_GS_SOLVER -- avoiding the profile mismatch of comparing against Soloviev's own Jt.
